summary: This document is a residential tenancy agreement for a property in Bahadurabad, Karachi, between Mr. Tariq Mehmood and Mrs. Sana Raza for a period of three years. By signing this, you agree to pay a monthly rent of Rs. 125,000 in advance and accept a 15% annual rent increase upon each renewal. You should pay close attention to the clauses regarding the annual rent hike and the landlord's right to re-enter the premises, as these sections contain terms that conflict with local rental laws. Please be aware that the agreement attempts to grant the landlord power to evict you without court involvement, which is not how the legal eviction process functions.

flagged_clauses.text:
1. Parties and premises. The Landlord lets the premises at
Bahadurabad, Karachi to the Tenant for residential use only.
flagged_clauses.note: This clause identifies the parties and premises as required by Section 5 of The Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979, which mandates that agreements be in writing.

flagged_clauses.text:
2. Rent. The Tenant shall pay monthly rent of Rs. 125,000 in
advance before the fifth day of each month. The rent shall stand
enhanced by fifteen per centum (15%) per annum on each renewal.
flagged_clauses.note: The 15% annual rent increase exceeds the 10% per annum maximum limit permitted under Section 9(2) of The Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979.

flagged_clauses.text:
3. Security deposit. The Tenant shall deposit two months rent as
security, refundable on vacation less lawful deductions.
flagged_clauses.note: The ordinance does not explicitly prohibit security deposits; however, note that Section 16 governs the handling of rent arrears and Section 12 provides for adjustments to rent for necessary repairs.

flagged_clauses.text:
4. Forfeiture and re-entry. On any default beyond seven days, the
Landlord shall, without notice or recourse to any court, be
entitled to re-enter the premises and take possession thereof.
flagged_clauses.note: Under Section 15 of The Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979, a landlord cannot unilaterally re-enter or evict a tenant; they must apply to the Controller for an eviction order.

flagged_clauses.text:
5. Term. This lease is for three years and the Tenant shall vacate
on or before 14 August 2029.
flagged_clauses.note: The term is a matter of private contract; however, any eviction upon expiry must still follow the legal procedures mandated by the Ordinance.

obligations.description: The Tenant must pay the monthly rent in advance.
The Tenant must vacate the premises.
